The location is top-notch—just outside the railway station, which makes it super convenient. As expected, it’s very crowded most of the time, and finding a table can be a bit difficult. However, the staff is really helpful and actively assists customers in managing seating and orders.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Tayade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Jeoy's Pizza at DN Nagar with my group of friends, and it turned out to be one of the best pizza experiences we've had in Mumbai. We had heard a lot about Jeoy's Pizza and its loyal fan following, so we decided to make the trip and see what the hype was all about. After our visit, it is safe to say that the reputation is well deserved.

We ordered two large pizzas – the Popeye Special Pizza and the Corn Exotica Pizza. Both pizzas arrived fresh, hot, and loaded with toppings. The quality was evident from the very first bite. The crust was perfectly baked, with a soft texture inside and a slight crispiness on the outside, making it an excellent base for the generous toppings.

The Popeye Special Pizza was an absolute delight. The combination of spinach, cheese, and seasonings created a rich and unique flavor that stood out from the usual pizza options. Even friends who were initially unsure about a spinach-based pizza ended up loving it. Every slice was packed with flavor, and the toppings were evenly distributed throughout.

The Corn Exotica Pizza was equally impressive. The sweet corn paired beautifully with the cheese and vegetables, creating a balanced and satisfying taste. It was fresh, cheesy, and incredibly enjoyable. The quality of ingredients could be felt in every bite, which is something that truly separates Jeoy's Pizza from many other pizza places.

What made the experience even more memorable was sharing these pizzas with friends. The large pizzas were perfect for our group, and everyone enjoyed both varieties. It was one of those meals where every slice disappeared quickly because nobody wanted to stop eating.

The service was friendly and efficient, and despite the popularity of the outlet, the staff ensured that everything was handled smoothly. The atmosphere was comfortable and welcoming, making it a great place to hang out with friends and enjoy good food.

One thing I would genuinely like to request to the Jeoy's Pizza team is to consider opening new outlets on the Central and Harbour railway lines, especially in areas such as Thane, Mulund, Ghatkopar, Vikhroli, or nearby locations. Many pizza lovers from these regions have to travel all the way to the Western line to enjoy Jeoy's Pizza. We happily made the journey because we love the taste, but having an outlet closer to Central and Harbour line commuters would make it accessible to a much larger customer base. I am sure many people from these areas would become regular customers if a new outlet were opened there.

Overall, Jeoy's Pizza delivered an outstanding experience with excellent taste, quality ingredients, and great value. The Popeye Special and Corn Exotica pizzas were both fantastic, and our entire group loved them. We will definitely be visiting again and highly recommend Jeoy's Pizza to anyone looking for delicious, memorable pizzas in Mumbai.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 – Worth the trip, and hoping to see a Jeoy's outlet on the Central Line soon!

The fries were crispy and golden brown, and I especially enjoyed the Brownie Shake which was thick and had a perfect blend of chocolate and creaminess. The Strawberry Cooler was a great way to beat the summer heat, and the range of drinks on offer was impressive.

One thing that stood out to me was that The Serial Griller has dine-in availability until 4am. This is a rarity in Mumbai, and I appreciated the convenience it offered. I would highly recommend The Serial Griller to anyone looking for a great burger joint that serves a unique range of burgers.

Overall, I had an excellent experience at The Serial Griller, and I can't wait to go back and try out more of their menu options.
